title: Reduction exponent
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols and a natural number $d$, define the reduction exponent to be $3wCoef(N,d)^2+3wCoef(N,d)+3$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
